terbaru.judul: Multi-Factor Inception: What to Do with All of These Features?
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we introduce Multi-Factor Inception Networks (MFIN), an end-to-end framework for systematic trading with multiple assets and factors.

terbaru.judul: Deep Inception Networks: A General End-to-End Framework for Multi-asset Quantitative Strategies
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce Deep Inception Networks (DINs), a family of Deep Learning models that provide a general framework for end-to-end systematic trading strategies.

terbaru.judul: Constructing Time-Series Momentum Portfolios with Deep Multi-Task Learning
terbaru.pelajaran: Inspired by recent progress in Multi-Task Learning (MTL), we present a new approach using MTL in a deep neural network architecture that jointly learns portfolio construction and various auxiliary tasks related to volatility, such as forecasting realized volatility as measured by different volatility estimators.

terbaru.judul: Efficient Estimation in Extreme Value Regression Models of Hedge Fund Tail Risks
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce a method to estimate simultaneously the tail and the threshold parameters of an extreme value regression model.

terbaru.judul: Physical Momentum in the Indian Stock Market
terbaru.pelajaran: Our study focuses on determining the presence of abnormal returns for physical momentum portfolios in the context of the Indian market.

terbaru.judul: Spatio-Temporal Momentum: Jointly Learning Time-Series and Cross-Sectional Strategies
terbaru.pelajaran: We introduce Spatio-Temporal Momentum strategies, a class of models that unify both time-series and cross-sectional momentum strategies by trading assets based on their cross-sectional momentum features over time.
This paper examines customer momentum, defined as a positive relationship between a firm's returns and past returns of its customers.

terbaru.judul: Investor base and idiosyncratic volatility of cryptocurrencies
terbaru.pelajaran: This paper investigates how changes in investor base is related to idiosyncratic volatility in cryptocurrency markets.

terbaru.judul: Stock price reaction to power outages following extreme weather events: Evidence from Texas power outage
terbaru.pelajaran: In this study, we evaluate the effects of natural disasters on the stock (market) values of firms located in the affected counties.

terbaru.judul: Transfer Ranking in Finance: Applications to Cross-Sectional Momentum with Data Scarcity
terbaru.pelajaran: In this paper, we introduce Fused Encoder Networks -- a novel and hybrid parameter-sharing transfer ranking model.
